prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1132; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather keep my name off the recording for now, if that's okay. You already have it in the file.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was stopped at a red light in Baytown, in the left lane, waiting to turn.
Q: What happened next?
A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The car behind me hit me going pretty fast, I'd say.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle right away?
A: I tried, but I felt dizzy and nauseous, so I stayed sitting for a while. Someone came over and asked if I was okay.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes. An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They did a CT scan and told me I had a concussion.
Q: Have you experienced any symptoms since then?
A: Yes. I get headaches almost every day, and bright lights bother my eyes. I also have trouble concentrating at work, and I forget things I was just told.
Q: Are you currently under a doctor's care for the concussion?
A: I am. I'm seeing a neurologist and I've been told to limit screen time and avoid driving when I have a bad headache.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was not using my phone and I was not at fault. I'm still recovering, and I'd appreciate it if this could be handled quickly.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
